description: Built-in bounded-scenario intent contract across O1 (Single-Session), O2 (Agent-Wide), and O3 (Global Environment).

scenarios.description: The agent ran tests, build, or linter commands in the last turn and at least one execution failed.

intents.description: Ask the agent to diagnose and fix the failing tests, build, or lint errors.
Ask the agent to explain the root cause or show detailed failure output first.

render.en: show me the root cause of the failure

intents.description: Ask the agent to re-run the failed command or tests (suspecting flakiness).
Tell the agent to ignore the failure for now and move on with the task.

render.zh-CN: 先跳过这个，继续下一步
render.en: skip this for now and continue

scenarios.description: The agent ended its message with a direct question or a numbered list of choices awaiting user decision.

intents.description: Approve or agree with the agent's proposed plan or default recommendation.
Pick one of the numbered options presented by the agent.
Ask the agent to compare the tradeoffs or clarify before deciding.

render.zh-CN: 先说说这几种做法的利弊
render.en: what are the tradeoffs between these options?

intents.description: Reject the proposed direction and ask for a simpler or different approach.

render.zh-CN: 不用这样，换个更简单的做法
render.en: no, let's use a simpler approach

scenarios.description: The agent modified or created files in this turn without running tests afterward.

intents.description: Ask the agent to run the relevant tests or typecheck to verify the changes.
Ask to inspect or review the diff of the changes made so far.
Ask the agent to briefly explain how or why the change was made this way.

render.zh-CN: 解释一下这处改动的原理
render.en: walk me through how this change works

intents.description: Ask the agent to proceed with the next step of the plan or implementation.
Ask the agent to stage and commit the current changes locally.

scenarios.description: The agent modified files and ran verification commands that all succeeded (0 failed execs).

intents.description: Ask the agent to commit the verified changes with a concise commit message.
Run a code review on the current changes before committing.

render.zh-CN: 先 review 一下全部改动

intents.description: Push the branch and open a pull request.
Proceed to the next item in the plan or task list.

render.en: move on to the next step

scenarios.description: A delegated subagent or background agent job just completed and returned its findings.

intents.description: Ask the main agent to integrate or apply the completed subagent's findings.

render.zh-CN: 结合子任务的结果继续处理
render.en: integrate the subagent findings and continue

intents.description: Ask the main agent to verify the subagent's output or run tests on its changes.

render.zh-CN: 验证一下后台任务的产出是否正确

intents.description: Check remaining open or review-ready tasks on the agent board.

render.zh-CN: 查看待审阅的任务卡片

scenarios.description: The user manually ran a command in the terminal outside the agent turn and it exited with a non-zero code.

intents.description: Ask the agent to diagnose and fix the terminal command failure.

render.zh-CN: 帮我看看刚才终端命令为什么报错并修一下
render.en: diagnose and fix the terminal command failure

intents.description: Ask the agent to explain the error output without modifying files yet.

render.zh-CN: 解释一下刚才终端里的报错原因
render.en: explain what caused that terminal error

scenarios.description: The user is focused on a file in the IDE that currently reports LSP compile/type errors, or copied a stacktrace.

intents.description: Ask the agent to fix errors in the active file or stacktrace.

render.zh-CN: 修一下当前文件里的类型/编译报错
render.en: fix the diagnostics errors in the active file

intents.description: Ask the agent to trace and explain the stacktrace or diagnostic error.

render.zh-CN: 分析一下这段报错栈的原因

scenarios.description: The agent ran read-only or inspection commands that succeeded without modifying files.

intents.description: Proceed with the next step based on the command output.
Ask the agent to explain or summarize the command output.

render.zh-CN: 解释一下这个输出结果

intents.description: Ask the agent to make the code changes implied by the inspection.
examples: go ahead and make the changes

render.en: go ahead and make the changes

scenarios.description: The agent inspected or searched the codebase (read-only tools only) and provided an explanation or plan without editing files.

intents.description: Ask the agent to go ahead and implement the changes or plan it just explained.

render.zh-CN: 按这个思路直接修改代码
render.en: go ahead and implement these changes

intents.description: Ask the agent to turn the analysis into a step-by-step implementation plan.
examples: 先列个详细的修改计划
break this down into a plan

render.zh-CN: 先列一份分步修改计划
render.en: write a step-by-step implementation plan first

intents.description: Ask for a concrete code example or call-site trace.
examples: 给个具体的代码示例看看
show me a concrete code example

render.zh-CN: 举个具体的代码调用例子
render.en: show me a concrete code example

scenarios.description: Fallback coding scenario when a turn completes normally without matching specialized edit/test/question triggers; uses a conservative high-threshold gate.

intents.description: Ask the agent to implement or execute the proposed approach.
Ask the agent to outline a concrete implementation plan first.
Ask for a concrete code snippet or example.

render.en: show me a concrete code example
